general_rules.rule: Every claim with mandatory binding ids must be preceded in the same paragraph group by a SCOPE_NODE carrying every binding id.
Every required CASE_SCOPE contains the complete required_case_ids set and required dependency.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_SCOPE immediately follows its governing claim and selects criterion_fact_ids as semantic subject.
CONDITIONAL_MAXIMUM remains adjacent to the applicable minima and retains its linked consequence.
Section and subsection headings are frozen non-material nodes; ordering is contract data, not planner discretion.
A claim marked redundant_summary is excluded only when all its atomic facts and qualifiers are present elsewhere in the same subsection.
